X1 screen 1 · Dupont 1 × 8 on a right-angle header

MOSI, in series (softer edges, SPI at 40 MHz)

GPIO21 → GND, small ceramic (no film: too wide)

bands 4.5–7 and 27.9–30.4 mm (rows 3 and 12): the lid tabs press on the edges, solder side; rows 12–13 under the
Assemble in this order: female headers (component side, square: plug them onto the S3 to solder), parts,
bridges, GND bus (tinned wire along column E), insulated jumpers, then the wires. Everything is done on the
Cut: 1.2 mm below row 1 and 2.7 mm above row 13, so the bottom edge is flush with the S3 USB edge (row 4 = first
pin row, 8.8 mm above that edge; check on the S3).
Single-sided board: only the solder-side pads hold the headers. Glue each header to the board (cyanoacrylate or
epoxy) once soldered, and hold the carrier to plug or pull the S3.
Before soldering the right header, remove the V contact (J4, USB-C VBUS): pushed out of the plastic from below,
or cut flush. The PC 5 V never reaches the carrier (J4 sits between GND J5 and MIC_SD I4).
Standing resistors (2.54 pitch), body under the S3: height ≤ 10 mm (11 mm free between carrier and S3). Headers
soldered first, then the standing parts bent towards the centre: R11–R14, R12, R20, C6 and C8 brush the header
Each wire is soldered to the tail of its pin or to its pad, solder side, then first runs flat inwards (columns
C–H) before going up or down: nothing within 5 mm of the left and right edges in bands 4.5–7 and 27.9–30.4 (lid
IO37 (I10) is the VSYS sense (Q4, R24; R23 sits in the harness at the power-path board end). EN (A11), IO43 /
IO44 (J11, J10) stay free: EN is the reset, not BL_EN.
Ohmmeter check, S3 removed: each wire ↔ its pin; GND (bus E) isolated from 3V3 (> 1 kΩ with C1 charged) and from
every signal, in particular BCLK (H4) and LRC (H6) on either side of the row 5 GND bridge, and VBAT/2 (B11) ↔ EN
